inspection_summary: Inspected all 1,974 Python splitlines from front matter through references. The usable body is a panoramic review whose reusable mechanisms are the prime-zero explicit formula, smooth/oscillatory density decompositions, periodic-orbit trace formulae, Hilbert-Polya spectral framing, scattering and inverse-spectral models, GUE statistics with nonuniversal corrections, Epstein-zeta lattice structure, thermodynamic pole/zero constraints, arithmetic gases, and number-theoretic random walks. Formula extraction is mostly recoverable from prose but the two-column text layer interleaves several page columns. The immutable u03 and u04 IDs and spans are carried, while their recorded v1 type labels conflict with the checked source and are explicitly flagged for provenance repair rather than silently reinterpreted.

accepted_units.title: GUE zero statistics are asymptotic and short-range, not complete dynamics
accepted_units.why_material: Montgomery-type correlations match GUE asymptotically and suggest broken time reversal, while finite-height, long-range, and small-spacing deviations are tied to system-specific short orbits; universal statistics therefore underdetermine a Hamiltonian.
accepted_units.context_note: The source separates asymptotic agreement from finite-scale discrepancies and empirical confirmation.

accepted_units.title: Arbitrary spectral realizability weakens bare Hilbert-Polya existence
accepted_units.why_material: An existence theorem supplies infinitely many integrable Hamiltonians for bounded sequences, including the zero sequence, but is nonconstructive; spectrum matching alone therefore does not identify a natural RH mechanism.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a source-stated limitation on treating any matching Hamiltonian as explanatory.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Quantum ergodicity separates universal averages from exceptional scars
accepted_units.why_material: Almost-all eigenstate averages may approach the classical microcanonical value while system-specific deviations and scars remain; this qualifies random-matrix universality as a scale-limited description.
accepted_units.context_note: The section is a methodological caution rather than a direct RH criterion.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Madelung lattice sums lead to Epstein zeta functions, but generalized RH fails for some forms
accepted_units.why_material: Electrostatic lattice energy becomes a quadratic-form zeta function with continuation and reflection symmetry, motivating a generalized critical-line conjecture; explicit existence of forms violating it blocks superficial transfer from Riemann zeta.
accepted_units.context_note: Conditional convergence and summation order are physically and mathematically material.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equations (41)-(46) and the Gram matrix are central; matrix/formula OCR should be scan-verified.

accepted_units.title: Specific heat determines phonon density and a physical zero-free strip
accepted_units.why_material: Möbius inversion and an alternative zeta-regularized transform recover phonon density from measured specific heat; high/low-temperature asymptotes force the denominator zeta to remain nonzero across a strip.
accepted_units.context_note: The source states the resulting bound is independent physical evidence but no stronger than known mathematics.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equations (47)-(50) are essential and formula-sensitive; validate transform variables and strip endpoints from the scan.

accepted_units.title: Zeta poles encode the dimensional threshold for ideal Bose condensation
accepted_units.why_material: Integrating the Bose occupation over a D-dimensional continuum produces a zeta value; negativity in one dimension and the pole at one in two dimensions obstruct a finite positive particle count, translating analytic singularities into phase-transition constraints.
accepted_units.context_note: This overlaps d17 because the normalized two-column page interleaves two distinct arguments.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equations (51)-(54) are central; exact constants are less important than the pole/positivity mechanism.

accepted_units.title: Spectral-zeta poles organize Bose fluctuations and partition asymptotics
accepted_units.why_material: A contour integral makes the leading pole control thermodynamic growth and subsequent poles finite-size corrections; the same calculation becomes a statement about integer partitions and exposes ensemble-dependent fluctuation behavior.
accepted_units.context_note: Column interleaving combines heat-capacity and fluctuation arguments, so both sides were checked together.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equations (54)-(55) and the three fluctuation regimes are formula-dependent; prose preserves the hierarchy.

accepted_units.title: Partition combinatorics yields persistent statistical-ensemble inequivalence
accepted_units.why_material: Counting partitions by number of summands gives non-Gaussian limits and shows microcanonical, canonical, and grand-canonical predictions for ground-state fluctuations need not agree, even where textbook equivalence is often assumed.
accepted_units.context_note: This left-column argument is interleaved with the primon-gas construction in d21.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Definitions of Φ and Ω are textually recoverable; one large numerical threshold is incidental.

accepted_units.title: Prime energies turn unique factorization into the Riemann-gas partition function
accepted_units.why_material: Assigning logarithmic energies to prime-labelled modes makes many-body occupation vectors identical to integer factorizations, so the bosonic partition function is ζ(s), its pole becomes a Hagedorn boundary, and fermionic exclusion selects square-free integers with ζ(s)/ζ(2s).
accepted_units.context_note: The physical gas is fictitious; the value lies in the exact structural correspondence.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equations (56)-(58) carry the partition functions and are readable in the normalized text.

accepted_units.title: Dirichlet and twisted convolutions model parafermion mixing and transmutation
accepted_units.why_material: Occupation caps interpolate between fermionic and bosonic gases, while Dirichlet/unitary convolutions encode free or interacting mixing and factor a coupled boson system into decoupled boson/fermion components.
accepted_units.context_note: The Möbius identity and square-free support give the exclusion interpretation; the source contains an apparent wording slip about which integers have μ=0.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equations (59)-(62) define the algebraic mechanism; verify convolution notation against the scan.

accepted_units.title: A uniquely occupied Riemann gas keeps zero microcanonical fluctuations
accepted_units.why_material: Unique factorization permits only one excited configuration at each logarithmic integer energy, giving zero microcanonical state fluctuations while canonical and grand-canonical predictions remain nonzero or divergent, even in the thermodynamic limit; an explicit logarithmic potential addresses realizability.
accepted_units.context_note: This right-column argument overlaps d22 in the interleaved extraction.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equations (63)-(64) give the proposed potential and semiclassical spectrum; exact constants require scan verification.

accepted_units.title: LeClair's thermodynamic zero-free argument depends on its decisive assumption
accepted_units.why_material: A scattering-kernel formalism makes physical thermodynamic quantities finite in a strip and argues that an off-line zero would violate an assumed interaction effect; the source explicitly identifies that assumption as why the claimed RH conclusion is not a proof.
accepted_units.context_note: Preserves the positive attack route and its failure condition together.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equations (65)-(66) and the kernel/potential forms are OCR-sensitive, while the logical limitation is explicit prose.

accepted_units.title: The Möbius random walk explains why a strong RH-sufficient bound can fail
accepted_units.why_material: Partial sums of the Möbius function define a walk; the Mertens square-root bound would imply RH but is known to fail at an enormous unknown location, showing both that a sufficient criterion need not be necessary and that vast computation can miss eventual counterexamples.
accepted_units.context_note: This right-column mechanism overlaps d24 because of two-column extraction.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The plot is nonessential; prose supplies the criterion, falsification status, and epistemic warning.

accepted_units.title: Prime-factor walks yield an Erdős-Kac Gaussian limit
accepted_units.why_material: Mapping distinct-prime-factor counts to a corrected random walk transfers Brownian/central-limit intuition into a limiting distribution for an arithmetic function.
accepted_units.context_note: The numerical illustration is routine; the reusable content is the representation and limit theorem.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Equation (67) is partially degraded but the Gaussian-limit claim is recoverable from prose.

accepted_units.title: High verified zeros do not exclude a still-higher RH counterexample
accepted_units.why_material: The source juxtaposes large-scale verification and statistical evidence with the possibility of an inaccessible off-line zero, explicitly separating computational success from proof.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a reusable evidence-calibration unit rather than a new mathematical construction.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-grounded; large numerical magnitudes are illustrative, not semantic prerequisites.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Trace formulas as a constrained spectral-design program
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Matching the smooth/oscillatory zero density to classical and quantum trace formulas converts primes into orbit data and yields concrete symmetry, dimensionality, stability, and self-adjointness constraints on any explanatory Hamiltonian.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The dictionary is nonunique, Selberg/scattering occurrences have not located the zeros, and self-adjoint spectral existence without a natural constructive operator is insufficient.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Smooth counts underdetermine the inverse spectral mechanism
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Many models reproduce the smooth zero count or even a chosen spectrum, but fluctuations, long-range correlations, boundary conditions, and naturalness determine whether the model carries explanatory RH content.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Two-column extraction and the u04 provenance conflict require source repair; inverse-spectrum agreement alone neither excludes off-line zeros nor singles out a canonical Hamiltonian.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Analytic singularities become physical feasibility boundaries
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Escape corrections, response-function inversion, particle-number positivity, phase-transition thresholds, and thermodynamic regularity translate poles or zeros of zeta functions into observable or feasibility constraints.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Experimental agreement can substantiate rather than prove RH, known zero-free regions may merely be recovered, and the strongest thermodynamic conclusion depends on an unproved physical assumption.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Arithmetic factorization as state space, statistics, and motion
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Quadratic forms, unique prime factorization, Möbius inversion, Dirichlet convolution, integer partitions, and prime-factor counts admit physical representations as lattice energies, many-body states, gas mixtures, fluctuations, and random walks.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Several systems are fictitious, ensemble choice changes predictions, generalized zeta analogies can fail, and probabilistic resemblance or a failed sufficient criterion does not settle RH.
